documents.unit: Junta de Gobierno, Universidad de Puerto Rico (system-wide, applies to Mayagüez)
documents.title: Política de Uso de Inteligencia Artificial en la Universidad de Puerto Rico (Certificación 66, 2024-2025)
documents.quality_note: System-wide regulation setting principles and governance for AI use in administrative, academic and research areas. Spanish text.

notes: System-wide policy, shared with Río Piedras. Searches found no UPRM campus-, college- or CIIC department-level AI policy. A copy hosted at rcm1.rcm.upr.edu is the same Certification 66 and was not collected separately.
